chapter: Cab Calloway, Lunceford, Hampton and Armstrong, 1941-45
title: Sally Webb and copyright renewals through John Eastman
summary: McRae put Chick Webb's widow in touch with lawyer John Eastman, who paid for the renewals of Chick's copyrights.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song
